nullable: exactly [type, null] or [null, type]; root cannot be nullable
object_policy: properties required, additionalProperties=false, no duplicate keys; any property order; generated property names use canonical JSON spelling
string_policy: Unicode scalar values; raw UTF-8 and JSON escapes with paired surrogates; canonical serialized spelling for primitive enum/const
number_policy: unconstrained numeric spelling <=32 bytes with at most two exponent digits; integer spelling <=18 digits; enum/const use finite canonical JSON numeric spelling
strict_tools: one strict function, required/named choice, parallel_tool_calls=false; envelope shares schema/output/depth limits
termination: auto-stop at complete validated object or complete strict tool frame; EOS masked; incomplete/dead-end/cancel/deadline/resource failure never reports conformant success
unqualified_combinations: custom stops with constraints or tools
json_object_mode: syntax-only root object with the same finite depth/string/item/property/output/tokenizer limits; generic property names need not be unique
